_comment: Central product registry (source of truth) — your plans live here. Every offering = ONE Digistore24 product. This list is deliberately hard-coded: reshape it or delete what you do not need. It feeds BOTH the plans page (/plans) and the sync script (scripts/ds24/sync-products.mjs), which creates the products at Digistore24 and writes the 'productId' back here. The PRICE stays HERE: it is not set on the DS24 product (the API discards data[amount]) but travels with every checkout call as a payment_plan built from 'priceCents'/'currency'/'billingInterval' — see lib/digistore/checkout.ts and docs/digistore-billing-modes.md. Do not create payment plans in the Digistore24 interface; the price would then live in two places and drift. The keys below ('basis_monatlich', 'pro', …) are identifiers, not display text: a token key travels to Digistore24 as 'tokens:<key>' in the custom field and is matched there by the IPN handler. Rename them only before your first live sale.
_billingModeComment: What this app sells: 'subscriptions' (plans only), 'tokens' (prepaid credit only) or 'both'. ONE switch — it turns off the surfaces of the model you do not use (a balance card stuck at 0, an empty 'next payment' card), so you do not have to hunt them down page by page. It is COSMETIC: hasPlan(), consumeTokens() and the IPN behave the same in every mode, and a mode only ever hides an EMPTY card — a customer who still holds tokens keeps seeing them after a switch. Set it, then delete the products below that you do not sell; lib/billing-mode.test.ts fails the build if the two contradict each other. Details: lib/billing-mode.ts.
